name: Recruiting desk
summary: A desk for a recruitment agency or independent recruiter: job orders from lead to placed, one pipeline entry per candidate, fee and guarantee dates, aftercare check-ins and a retention date on every candidate.
description: Run an agency desk in one place: clients and their terms of business, job orders with a stage and an expected fee, candidates submitted per job with their own stages, placements with the guarantee end date and aftercare check-ins, and a retention review date on every candidate. It fits a desk of one to five recruiters. It is not a job board, a CV parser, a bulk outreach tool or a timesheet and payroll system, and nothing is sent to candidates or clients automatically.

prompt.intro: Set up a recruiting desk in my Customermates workspace: clients with their terms, job orders with nine stages and an expected fee, one submission per candidate and job, placements with the guarantee end and aftercare check-ins, and a keep-until date on every candidate.
questions: Do you work on contingency, retained or both, and what fee and guarantee do you usually agree?
How many job orders and candidates do you handle at once, and who owns which stage?
How long do you keep candidate data, and in which countries do you recruit?
Where do you keep signed terms and invoices? Only a link or a reference is kept here.
